name: ECHO–9 field machinery and mineral fauna
request: Rework robot and monster modeling to reduce the cartoon appearance

technical_frame.view: Third-person perspective, close model review and actual gameplay camera
technical_frame.scale: 18 world units per metre; existing collision footprints and rig sockets retained
technical_frame.robot_budget: At most 65000 triangles, at most 10 material batches
technical_frame.creature_budget: At most 45000 triangles near, 12000 distant, five material draws per animal

visual_target.robot: Grounded expedition machine: compact recessed sensor assembly, structural torso, chamfered service panels, load-bearing limbs, sealed pivots, hydraulic lines, functional cooling, restrained optical emission
visual_target.creatures: Connected arthropod anatomy: long predatory head, heavy ram skull, armored spore chambers, weight-bearing tendons and hooked claws; layered eroded chitin with subdued mineral and fibrous surface response
visual_target.palette: Desaturated field grey, olive and steel; dark umber and mineral chitin; small amber/cyan sensory accents
visual_target.motion: World-planted feet and joint-connected mechanisms; restrained idle movement; readable attack anticipation

production.robot: New editable Blender source and GLB, generated by tools/build-aegis-field.py
production.creatures: Editable anatomical mesh definitions in dist/exo-creature-models.mjs, shared geometry with separate instance rigs and two detail tiers
production.textures: Existing Poly Haven CC0 metal scans on armor and desaturated rock scans with alpha-height bump on creature shells; original deterministic color/normal/roughness maps remain the creature fallback
production.approval: Direction selected within delegated redesign; actual mesh and in-game visual review required before release
